# Wayland client dependencies

XtMapper compiles Wayland 1.24.0 and libffi 3.4.6 into its Android JNI library.
This directory contains the client source subset, per-ABI libffi configuration
and client protocol bindings generated by the Wayland 1.24.0 scanner. Both
upstream licenses are included. Server and cursor libraries are outside the
Android build.

To regenerate this directory on Linux, set `ANDROID_NDK_HOME` to the NDK
configured in `app/build.gradle.kts` and run
`app/src/main/cpp/refresh-wayland-client.sh` from the repository root. The
script requires a host C toolchain, Bash, curl, tar, Meson, Ninja, pkg-config
and the Expat development package. It checks the upstream archive hashes
before extracting and uses the protocol XML already in the repository.
Expat is used by the host scanner and is outside the APK. Ordinary Android
builds compile the checked-in sources and require no host scanner.
